content:
sam: Postmortem follow-up: last night we hit an eviction cascade in gpu-pool-prod. Root cause: small traffic spike + preemption policy + autoscaler reaction delay. Need owners for remediation items; keeping this thread as the canonical tracker. Postmortem: https://wiki/redwood/incidents/17661-capacity-cascade.

lina: I can own Action 1: quota tuning (reduce burst reservations, tighten quota per-namespace). ETA Fri 2026-03-26, will open PR and include unit tests.

omar: I'll take Action 2: scheduler knobs & canary. Need eviction logs and scheduler profiles. @chen can you attach?

chen: Logs uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/17661/logs.tar.gz. Notable excerpt:
```
[kube-scheduler] preempt attempts=23
pod worker-9 evicted at 03:04:12 UTC reason=InsufficientGPU
autoscaler: observed scale_up_latency=48s backlog=140
```

devops-bot: Created task: HUD-3842 headroom-trial (owner=lina). Reminder set for 2026-03-29.

sam: Action 3: headroom trial proposal (lina) -> reserve +12% GPUs nightly for 10 days, measure p95 latency & cost delta. Evaluation date: 2026-04-06.

lina: Also proposing an alert: if burst_rate > 30req/s and pool_free_gpus < 10 -> page capacity-oncall and open transient ticket. Will include in PR.

omar: Scheduler changes planned: reduce preemption aggressiveness, increase eviction_threshold 0.04 -> 0.07, add a 25s preemption cooldown. Canary on cluster-canary-1 first.

chen: Pattern note: sequence is consistent across incidents: traffic burst -> queue growth -> evictions -> slow scale-up. Suggest new composite metrics: burst_to_eviction_ms and eviction_to_scale_ms and a rule to alert when both exceed thresholds.

sam: Owners confirmed: lina/omar. Please ack and paste PR/task links here when ready.

lina: acknowledged, will post PR by EOD Thu.

omar: ack, will schedule canary and synthetic burst test tomorrow and share results.

devops-bot: Weekly follow-up reminder created. Next ping: 2026-03-25.

sam: Thanks team. I'll update the master tracker and close after headroom evaluation.
